title: Stepper steps
description: The steps of the explainer, in order. Boxes and arrows that no step shows are visible from the start.

title.description: Short heading for the step, shown above its text.

text.description: One or two sentences explaining the step.

show.description: ids of the boxes and arrows that appear at this step and stay. Arrows are called "from->to" unless they have their own id.

highlight.description: ids drawn in the accent colour during this step. Default: the ids in show.

hide.description: ids removed from this step on.
